sentences.text:
The Hon'Ble Sri Justice K.Sarath
 Writ Petition No.21546 of 2023
Order:

This Writ Petition is filed under the Article 226 of Constitution of India seeking following relief:
" ...to issue Writ, Order or Direction or any other appropriate Order one in the nature of a WRIT OF MANDAMUS declaring the action of the Respondent No.5 releasing the land acquisition amount in favour of the Respondents No.7 to 9 for the land in Sy.No.155/22/E admeasuring Ac.4-00gts&Sy.No.186/10/A admeasuring AC.2-00 gts altogether admeasuring AC.6-00gts situated at MucherlaVillage,Kandukur Mandal,
Ranga Reddy District knowing well that they are not the owner of the subject property and there are civil suits are pending between the parties vide 1) O.S. No.
824/2017 pending before the Hon'ble III Addl. District Judge, Ranga Reddy District,
2) O.S.No.239/2012 new O.S.No.436/2020 pending before Hon'ble III Addl. District Judge, Ranga Reddy District, 3) O.S.No.1184/2018 pending before the Principal Senior Civil Judge, Ranga Reddy District, 4) O.S.No.127 of 2022 pending before the Principal Senior Civil Judge CUM Assistant Sessions Judge, Ranga Reddy District as per the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013 the land acquisition amounts has to deposit before the authorities as illegal, arbitrary and violation of articles 14, 21,
300A of Constitution of India and consequently direct the Respondent No.5 not to release any amount for the land in Sy.No.155/ 22/ E admeasuring Ac.4-00gts &
Sy.No.186/ 10/A admeasuring AC.2-00 gts altogether admeasuring AC.6-00gts situated at MucherlaVillage,Kandukur Mandal, Ranga Reddy District in favour of Respondents No.7 to 9..."
Heard both sides and perused the material on record.

3. Learned Counsel for the petitioner submits that the main grievance of the petitioner herein is that mother of the petitioner has submitted a representation dated 12.12.2022 to the respondent No.5 not to release compensation amount to anyone for the land acquired in Sy.No.155/22/E admeasuring Ac.4-00 guntasand Sy.No.186/10/A admeasuring Ac.2-00 guntas altogether admeasuring Ac.6-00guntas situated at Mucherla Village, Kandukur Mandal, Ranga Reddy District,
as there are four civil suits viz., 1)O.S.No.824 of 2017 before the III Addl. District Judge, Ranga Reddy District, 2)O.S.No.239 of 2012 (new O.S.No.436 of 2020) before the III Addl. District Judge,
Ranga Reddy District, 3)O.S.No.1184 of 2018 before the Principal Senior Civil Judge, Ranga Reddy T. Hari Krishna vs The State Of Telangana on 16 April, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/5206951/
1 District,
4)O.S.No.127 of 2022 before the Principal Senior Civil Judge- cum-Assistant Sessions Judge, Ranga Reddy District, which are pending against the same schedule property.

4.

entities.text: Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: Learned Government Pleader for Land Acquisitionappearing for the respondent No.5, basing on the counter affidavit, submits that with regard to the land in Sy.No.155/22/E measuring Ac.4-00 guntas of Mucherla Village, which is acquired and included to an extent of Ac.102.28 guntas of land in Sy.No.155 of Mucherla Village and for the same acquisition of land, notification and declaration were issued and published under the Act, 2013.

The Award in this case was passed, for an extent of Ac.102.08 guntas in Sy.No.155 and Ac.45.28 guntas in Sy.No.288 total admeasuring Ac.148.11 guntas, vide Award No.A2/2331/ ::4::
SK, J Mucherla/2017 dated 28.11.2022, wherein the award for an extent of Ac.4-00 guntas in Sy.No.155/22/E of Rs.1,00,00,000.00/-(Rupees one crore only) was passed in the name of the father of the petitioner and in remarks column it is mentioned that O.S.No.824 of 2017 filed by Terati Mounika D/o Gopal and O.S.No.1184 of 2018 filed by Terati Ramakrishna and another are pending before the Civil Courts.

The compensation for an extent of Ac.4-00 guntas in Sy.No.155/22/E has not been paid to any person as there is dispute over the land, and the case is being referred to the Authority under Section 76 of the Act, 2013 and the compensation amount is being deposited before the Authority.

5. Learned Government Pleader for Land Acquisition further submits that in respect of land admeasuring Ac.2-00 guntas in Sy.No.186/10/A of Mucherla Village, the enquiry was conducted wherein it was confirmed that the respondent No.7 is the 2nd wife of the father of the petitioner and she is entitled for the compensation for half () share in Ac.2-00 guntas as such the compensation for Ac.1-00 guntas was paid ::5::
SK, J to the daughters of the respondent No.7 and remaining half () share compensation for Ac.1-00 guntas in the name of the Smt. Sujatha mother of the petitioner herein, but they have not received the said compensation.
Therefore, there are no merits in the writ petition and requested to dismiss the same.

6. After hearing both sides and perusing the entire material on record, this Court is of the considered view that there are disputes between the petitioner and unofficial respondents and also T. sentences.text: there are total four civil suits pending between the parties in the same land acquisition proceedings.

The official respondents have deposited Rs.1,00,00,000/- (Rupees one crore only) with regard to Land Acquisition Award under Section 76 of the Act, 2013 for the land admeasuring Ac.4-00 guntas in Sy.No.155/22/E of Mucherla Village, Kandukur Mandal, Ranga Reddy District.

Whereas in the instant case also, the petitioner seeks to refer the matter under Section 76 of the Act, 2013 in respect of the land admeasuring Ac.2-00 guntas in Sy.No.186/10/A of Mucherla Village, Kandukur Mandal,
Ranga Reddy District.

The official ::6::
SK, J respondents have already taken stand with regard to the land situated in Sy.No.155/22/E admeasuring Ac.4-00 guntas by referring the matter to the Land Acquisition Authority under Section 76 of the Act, 2013, but, the same was not extended for the land of Ac.2-00 guntas in Sy.No.186/10/A of Mucherla Village.
In spite of the civil suits pending between the parties, the official respondents paid half of the amount to the unofficial respondents.

Therefore, the official respondents have to refer the matter under Section 76 of the Act, 2013 as there are rival claims between the parties for the same land acquisition notification for the land of Ac.2-00 guntas in Sy.No.186/10/A of Mucherla Village.

7. In view of the same, the writ petition is disposed of by directing the official respondents to refer the matter under Section 76 of the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013 in respect of the land in Sy.No.186/10/A admeasuring Ac.2-00 guntas situated in Mucherla Village, Kandukur Mandal, Ranga Reddy District in ::7::
SK, J pursuance to Award proceedings No.A2/684/2019 dated 30.12.2021 as the official respondents referred the matter with regard to the land in Sy.No.155/22/E admeasuring Ac.4-00 guntas situated in Mucherla Village, Kandukur Mandal, Ranga R e d d y D i s t r i c t i n p u r s u a n c e t o t h e L a n d A c q u i s i t i o n A w a r d No.A2/2331/Mucherla/2017 dated 28.11.2022 within three (03) months from the date of receipt of copy of this Order.
Till the disposal of the referred matters, the respondents are directed not to release any amount to either of the parties.
However, there shall be no order as to costs.
8. Miscellaneous petitions pending, if any, in this writ petition shall standclosed.

JUSTICE K.SARATH Date: 16.04.2024 spk T. Hari Krishna vs The State Of Telangana on 16 April, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/5206951/
